items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: like the trumpet player with Jimmy Luneford, Steve -- I forget his -- he was a high note guy. (Tommy Stevenson)

ctx.x: Yeah, to smoke, you know. And the big bands, that's as far as they went, you know. Very rarely you would hear of anyone in the days that we're talking about that were so fantastically New York, was going for anything else but pot. Every now and then you would hear of a guy going way out on a limb trying something else, like the trumpet player with Jimmy Luneford, Steve -- I forget his -- he was a high note guy. (Tommy Stevenson)
